title: Capsa link
description: A typed edge between two records (core v0.4.0, section Links). Authored in one direction only; the inverse is computed by consumers, never stored. An edge whose target is an ancestor of the record carrying it is non-conforming — the path already states it — which is a rule about the pair, so it is checked by a validator rather than by this schema.

rel.description: Core vocabulary, or an x- prefixed private token. An unknown rel must be preserved and may be traversed.

to.description: An address: an internal path from the format directory, an internal path relative to the record's own directory (./… or ../…), or an external @capsule-slug/path.
